notes: Yarn Classic official installer with release tarball, detached GPG signature and official public key; native GPG verification retained. Includes Node.js 22.15.0 so local package scripts execute offline. Adjusts hardcoded ~/.yarn to requested prefix and quotes binary paths. Yarn packages beyond the bundled manager/runtime require a separate offline cache.
Upstream installer is fetched at build time from a pinned commit. No upstream script snapshot is vendored in the skill.

Installer repository has no established license grant. Full script remains runtime-fetch-only; recipe retains only minimal identification anchors and independently authored replacements. Generated bundles require their own redistribution review.
